strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Dynamic Resolution through DNS Calculation

analytics.name: Analytic 0728
analytics.guidance: Monitor DNS query results where subsequent connections use derived or unusual port numbers not explicitly resolved, especially when tied to suspicious processes. Correlate Sysmon DNS logs (Event ID 22) with process creation and socket activity.

tuning.description: Deviation from common service ports (e.g., >1024 when DNS resolved service expects 80/443)
Correlation window between DNS response and network connection (e.g., 5 minutes)

analytics.name: Analytic 0729
analytics.guidance: Inspect resolver and audit logs for processes initiating outbound connections to ports calculated from DNS response IPs. Abnormal ephemeral port usage shortly after DNS queries can indicate DNS calculation behavior.

tuning.description: Configured ephemeral port ranges per environment to reduce false positives
Exclude trusted resolvers or internal services from analysis

log_sources.name: linux:syslog
log_sources.channel: DNS response IPs followed by connections to non-standard calculated ports

analytics.name: Analytic 0730
analytics.guidance: Use unified logs to detect unusual DNS responses correlated with subsequent connections to calculated or non-standard ports. Monitor non-browser apps making repeated outbound connections that deviate from expected patterns.

tuning.description: Expected processes allowed to open non-standard ports (e.g., developer tools)
Volume of unusual connections needed before flagging as suspicious

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: DNS responses followed by connections to ports outside standard ranges

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Unexpected processes making network calls based on DNS-derived ports

analytics.name: Analytic 0731
analytics.guidance: Analyze ESXi syslogs for management agents or VMs making outbound connections to dynamically calculated ports derived from DNS responses. Cross-check with VM traffic baselines to identify anomalies.

tuning.description: Known trusted ESXi management plane IPs to exclude from alerts
Integrate external feeds for reputation context on DNS-derived domains

log_sources.name: esxi:syslog
log_sources.channel: DNS resolution events leading to outbound traffic on unexpected ports
